scope: Actual Mac App mesh-resolution retries and steady external flow with independent topology, flux and momentum audit; aerodynamic accuracy is not qualified.

benchmark.benchmarkCaveat: No matched circular-cylinder reference: only the declared stability, geometry and discrete-balance checks apply. This is not a physical accuracy qualification.

derivedBodyCoefficients.definition: 2 F / (U^2 D), unit density and depth

cellResidual.denominatorDefinition: (uDiagonal+vDiagonal)*speed; nu*T plus upwind flux; fixed component uses nu*T; incoming normal-inlet u flux is on RHS, not diagonal; transient adds measuredArea/dt per component

faceConsistencyTolerance.meaning: CSV reconstruction comparison only; pressure in m2/s2 and momentum flux in m3/s2; not a CFD accuracy gate

momentumAudit.fullNewtonianForceAudit: forceX/forceY selected by viscousStress; reconstructedForceX/Y remain the cell-gradient diagnostic

globalBoundaryMomentum.denominatorDefinition: sum over boundary faces of |p*Sx|+|p*Sy|+|advectionX|+|advectionY|+|diffusionX|+|diffusionY|; zero if all terms zero

globalSourceBalance.definition: global boundary momentum minus independent volume source integral

native.pressureReference: right outlet faces, kinematic pressure zero
native.scope: steady constant-property laminar flow; no turbulence or accuracy certification
